<thought>Based on the described intramolecular Michael addition cyclization of chalcones to flavanones, the retrosynthetic step breaks the newly formed C‑C and C‑O bonds, regenerating the open‑chain hydroxy‑chalcone precursor. The most plausible precursor is the hydroxy‑chalcone O=C(C=Cc1ccccc1)C2=CC=CC=C2O, which can exist as E or Z isomers (both map to the same SMILES without explicit stereochemistry). Therefore the set of possible precursors is a single combination containing this molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O=C(C=Cc1ccccc1)C2=CC=CC=C2O"]]</final_answer>
